To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
electrical coupling between some subclasses CCK cells is modulated by the release of endocannabinoid.
Electrical coupling between some CCK cells in the CA1 stratum pyramidale of hippocampus is modulated by the release of endocannabinoid.
electrical coupling between CTK interneurons is modulated by endocannabinoids released at the chemical synapses between CCK cells.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the role of electrical coupling between CTK interneurons in the modulation of endocannabinoid release.
the modulation of electrical coupling between CTK interneurons that are interconnected via both electrical and chemical synapses.
the role of electrical synapses and endocannabinoid release in modulating the activity of CCK inter-neuronal networks.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the endocannabinoid system modulates electrical and chemical coupling in CCK cells.
endocannabinoid release modulates electrical coupling between CTK cells connected via chemical and/or electrical synapses in CA1.
electrical synapses in the hippocampus are modulated by endocannabinoids and this modulation is activity-dependent.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the electrical synapses between CCK cells are not only important in the generation of rhythmic synchronous activity but also in the modulation of endocannabinoid release.
electrical coupling between CTK cells, which are interconnected via chemical and electrical synaptic transmission, are modulated by endocannabinoids in a CB1 dependent manner.
electrical and chemical synapses between CCK cells are modulated by endocannabinoid release.
The main takeaway from our work is that
electrical coupling between CTK cells is modulated by the actions of endogenous cannabinoids.

the electrical and chemical synapses between CCK cells are synergistically modulated by endocannabinoids and that these interactions are likely to play important roles in the coordination of network activity.
endocannabinoid-mediated synaptic plasticity can modulate the strength of electrical coupling between neurons.
